_why: The premade build already reaches Barricade, Incite, Controlled Aggression
and Damage Shield -- most of the Protection redesign -- because the rage
rework happened below the talent layer. What it misses is the part that
keeps a solo warrior alive without a healer, and one point of the damage:
Safeguard 2/2             (T7.2) blocking enables Victory Rush, which
heals 20% of maximum health in any stance. For
a warrior blocking constantly this is a heal on
a short natural cooldown, and it is the only
self-healing the spec has.
Blood and Thunder 2/2     (T3.1) Thunder Clap on a Rend target spreads
Rend. Paired with Improved Thunder Clap, which
is now Thunderstruck -- a bleed for up to 100%
of block value.
Improved Thunder Clap 2/3 -> 3/3  the third point of that bleed.
Funded by four things that need a party or a non-boss:
Vigilance 1/1           targets a party member. Worth precisely nothing
alone. Note its prerequisite is Barricade, so it
can be dropped without disturbing anything.
Shockwave 1/1           a cone stun. Bosses are stun-immune.
Improved Disciplines 2/2 cooldown reduction on Shield Wall, Recklessness
and Retaliation -- two of which this build never
presses.
Cruelty 1/5             the Fury dip's last stray point.
Note what is deliberately NOT changed. This is still a tank strategy being
asked to kill something alone, and under the new rage model Shield Slam and
Revenge are generators rather than sinks, so the stock threat-first ordering
is closer to correct than it looks. docs/prot_warrior_rage_audit.md should
be read before retuning any of it -- the right answer to a bad measurement
here may be a config change rather than a talent or relevance change.
52 Protection / 16 Arms / 3 Fury.
